hidden_plates.note: the hidden sites' plate bundles (the plate backend's offline environment of each scored site, one folder h01 ... h10 per site, renamed at install to the site package sha256 its meta.json records), not in the repository and never in the image: verify.py fetch_hidden_plates downloads this tarball of the benchmark's asset dataset before the first episode, checks its sha256 and file count and installs it into plate_root under the root-only stage; the url names the dataset commit that environment/assets.sha256 pins, and a local copy tests/assets/plates.tar.xz (not in git), when present, replaces the download (tests/test.sh points ARB_HIDDEN_PLATES_TARBALL at it)

note: run settings only. `limits` are the cell's budgets (voidcell/_lib/budgets.py keys; mission() announces them): the simulated-time limit is NOT here, it comes from hidden/limits.json (time_limit_s, frozen with the hidden set), and the per-point report budget comes from voidscore/acceptance.yaml (reports_per_point), the single source of every scoring threshold (weights, credit radii, dwell window and still tolerance, retrieval radius and factors). program_time_s caps the program's own time per episode (the wall clock minus the cell's simulation and rendering: cellkit.wire), silence_s the time from a reply to the next request, cpu_s the program's CPU seconds (prlimit). pose_source: 'estimated' (default: pose() answers not_available; the program estimates the pose from the frames) or 'cell' (voidcell/_lib/pose_source.py); the practice ground's configuration carries the same value. render_backend 'plate_filament' is the search camera's plate backend: each site's plate bundle under plate_root (relative to the staged tests/; verify.py installs the hidden sites' bundles there from hidden_plates before the first episode); the practice ground's configuration names the same backend and its own plate_root. privileged_program_time_cap_s caps the oracle's episodes, whose reference program steps the cell inside its one call (reference_run). The practice ground runs the same limits (environment/practice_ground/sites.json carries a copy; the calibration site has its own simulated-time limit).
